```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list=ls())
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, ggplot2, googlesheets4, janitor)
```
#Kelp on Grazer Assay Bars 
```{r}
#importing google sheets 
GA_kelp_weights = 
"https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1d1CjDTCh7g108fjLrHlKTLF5tQDqrwpcJNINKTru3uI/edit?gid=0#gid=0"

kelp_on_GA <- read_sheet(GA_kelp_weights, sheet = "Sheet1")
```
```{r}
#averaging mean weight 
build_1 <- kelp_on_GA %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  group_by(date, site, plot, id, arkev, drift, time) %>%
  summarise(mean_weight_g = mean(weight_g))

#adding in plots from post time that had no kelp 
# get the unique site/plot/id/arkev/drift combos surveyed in pre
pre_combos <- build_1 %>%
  filter(time == "Pre") %>%
  distinct(site, plot, id, arkev, drift)

# find which of those combos never show up in post
missing_post <- pre_combos %>%
  anti_join(build_1 %>% filter(time == "Post"), by = c("site", "plot", "id", "arkev"))

# build the zero-weight rows for those missing plots
zero_rows <- missing_post %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date("2026-07-14"), # post survey date
    time = "Post",
    mean_weight_g = 0)

# bind back into the main df
build_2 <- bind_rows(build_1, zero_rows) %>%
  arrange(plot, id, arkev, time)

build_3 <- build_2 %>%
  group_by(arkev, drift, time) %>%
  mutate(treatment = paste(arkev, drift, sep = "_")) %>%
  group_by(treatment, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_weight = mean(mean_weight_g),
    se_weight = sd(mean_weight_g) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(time = factor(time, levels = c("Pre", "Post"))) # keep pre before post

#renaming treatments
label_lookup <- c(
  "ARKEV_drift"      = "ARKEV + Drift",
  "ARKEV_no_drift"   = "ARKEV + No Drift",
  "Control_drift"    = "Control + Drift",
  "Control_no_drift" = "Control + No Drift")

build_3 <- build_3 %>%
  mutate(treatment_label = recode(treatment, !!!label_lookup))

ggplot(build_3, aes(x = treatment_label, y = mean_weight, fill = time)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_weight - se_weight, ymax = mean_weight + se_weight),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pre" = "gray80", "Post" = "gray30")) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Mean kelp weight (g)",
    fill = "Deployment Period"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

```
```{r}
build_4 <- build_2 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-date)

build_5 <- build_4 %>%
  mutate(treatment = paste(arkev, drift, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(plot, id, treatment, time, mean_weight_g) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mean_weight_g) %>%
  mutate(pct_change = ((Post - Pre) / Pre) * 100)

build_6 <- build_5 %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct_change = mean(pct_change),
    se_pct_change = sd(pct_change) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(treatment_label = recode(treatment, !!!label_lookup))

build_7 <- build_6 %>%
   mutate(drift = ifelse(grepl("no_drift", treatment), "no_drift", "drift"))

ggplot(build_7, aes(x = treatment_label, y = mean_pct_change, fill = drift)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_pct_change - se_pct_change, ymax = mean_pct_change + se_pct_change),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("drift" = "#6E8B3D", "no_drift" = "grey")) +
  labs(
    title = "Effects of drift enhancement on kelp biomass of GA bars",
    subtitle = "% change in kelp weight (g) before and after drift deployment (24hrs)",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "% change",
    fill = "Treatment Type" ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))
```
